I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the settled seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal is **261 seats**.

- **Source:** Ilse posted 261 in #north-team on Oct 14, and nothing in the channel has changed it since. Dana is a member of #north-team, so I only used messages she can see herself.
- **Older figure:** I also told her that the 185 from August 2025 is the Amendment No. 1 count (she corrected it from 180 at the time). It isn't the 2026 renewal, so it shouldn't go in the tracker.
- **Sharing:** a seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so it was fine to post in the team channel.
